entities.name: Eugene McLanahan Wilson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eugene McLanahan Wilson was an American lawyer and Democratic politician who served in various legal and political offices in Minnesota including as a member of Congress and as the fifth and seventh mayor of Minneapolis.
